gemini-nano-banana-2.1.summary: Google documents up to 14 references, with up to 10 object references and four character references. The model also supports 1K, 2K, and 4K output.
gemini-nano-banana-2.1.scope: Gemini API image generation and reference inputs.
gemini-nano-banana-2.1.label: Google Gemini image generation guide

gemini-nano-banana-2.1.summary: Nano Banana 2.1 reproduced the requested wording in all nine images in ppl.studio’s OCR check. Nano Banana 2 reproduced it in seven.
gemini-nano-banana-2.1.scope: Three English prompts, three attempts each, and two OCR passes in a practitioner’s own workflow.
gemini-nano-banana-2.1.label: ppl.studio Nano Banana comparison

firefly_image.summary: Adobe’s Image5 API uses the same payload for creation and editing. It generates from text when the reference list is empty and makes a prompt-driven edit when it contains images.
firefly_image.scope: Firefly Services Generate Image API using `referenceBlobs`.
firefly_image.label: Adobe Image5 feature guide

firefly_image.summary: Arcnel reported more than ten failed attempts to get a usable left-side view of a character with Image5 while preparing references for a 3D model.
firefly_image.scope: One character turnaround in the Firefly web app in August 2026.
firefly_image.label: Arcnel character turnaround test

gpt-image-2.6-sunburst.summary: OpenAI recommends lower complexity for focused edits such as replacing a background. Higher complexity can help with dense text or layout, with possible latency and unwanted changes.
gpt-image-2.6-sunburst.scope: GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst through the Image API. Complexity controls planning, and quality controls rendering.
gpt-image-2.6-sunburst.label: OpenAI image generation guide

gpt-image-2.6-sunburst.summary: Instant Studio reported that Sunburst preserved the product through five successive changes to a café scene, each applied to the previous output.
gpt-image-2.6-sunburst.scope: One product packshot and one five-edit sequence using the default high complexity setting.
gpt-image-2.6-sunburst.label: Instant Studio five-round editing test

ideogram-4-6.summary: Setting `magic_prompt` to `off` preserves the wording when a natural-language prompt is structured for generation. The API also accepts a mask for localized edits to the first source image.
ideogram-4-6.scope: Ideogram 4.6 generation API. Generated lettering still needs proofreading.
ideogram-4-6.label: Ideogram 4.6 generation API

ideogram-4-6.summary: Ideogram 4.6 Precise Edit at High Quality placed first on Rapidata’s November 25 multi-step editing leaderboard. Its 95% interval overlaps that of Ideogram 4.5.
ideogram-4-6.scope: Pairwise human judgments of identity preservation over a fixed set of sequential edits. This configuration differs from the medium-quality generation preset.
ideogram-4-6.label: Rapidata Multi-Step Image Editing benchmark

qwen-image-3.0-pro.summary: QwenCloud describes support for rendering text in 12 languages and for composing dense layouts such as menus and storyboards. Check the output with a reader of each language before reusing rendered copy.
qwen-image-3.0-pro.scope: Hosted QwenCloud image generation. Language coverage comes from the provider’s model page.
qwen-image-3.0-pro.label: QwenCloud model reference

qwen-image-3.0-pro.summary: Artificial Analysis lists Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro separately from Qwen-Image-3.0 in its Text-to-Image Arena. The Pro variant had the higher estimate in the November 25 check.
qwen-image-3.0-pro.scope: AA-Image-T2I v2.1 overall human preference. This task does not measure whether localized wording is reproduced exactly.
qwen-image-3.0-pro.label: Artificial Analysis Text-to-Image Arena

flux-3-image.summary: Black Forest Labs documents a multi-reference workflow and optional bounding boxes for layout and edits. With automatic framing, the requested ratio takes precedence, followed by the first reference’s framing when present.
flux-3-image.scope: FLUX 3 Image API. Bounding boxes are prompt inputs, and exact dimensions are available separately.
flux-3-image.label: Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 Image API

flux-3-image.summary: When swapping a paper cup for a mug in one café photo, Fuser measured changes in 0.4% of pixels outside the edit area with FLUX 3 Image and 7.7% with GPT Image 2.5 Flare.
flux-3-image.scope: One local edit in Fuser, using its pixel-difference threshold and the specific configurations in the report.
flux-3-image.label: Fuser typography and editing test

Qwen/Qwen-Image-2512.summary: Qwen’s Diffusers example uses 50 inference steps and a true guidance scale of 4.0. It lists 1664 × 928 pixels for wide output and 1328 × 1328 pixels for square output.
Qwen/Qwen-Image-2512.scope: Reference settings for local text-to-image generation using CUDA.
Qwen/Qwen-Image-2512.label: Qwen-Image-2512 model card

Qwen/Qwen-Image-2512.summary: Two 50-step, 1328 × 1328 generations took about 78 seconds each in an Igor’sLAB workstation test. The reported GPU memory use was around 31,000 MiB in both runs.
Qwen/Qwen-Image-2512.scope: One RTX 5090 Windows workstation using ComfyUI. Timing includes text encoding and decoding.
Qwen/Qwen-Image-2512.label: Igor’sLAB workstation test report
